references.text: Earlier in the chapter it is mentioned that the remaining sons of Kohath received cities from the tribes of Ephraim, Dan, and half of Manasseh, which verse 26 summarizes.
These verses list the individual cities given to the remaining Kohathite families, and verse 26 gives a total of ten cities with pastureland.
God commands that the Levites shall receive cities with surrounding pastureland, which is fulfilled in the allocation to the descendants of Kohath.
Parallel text describing how the remaining Kohathite families received cities from half the tribe of Manasseh.
Parallel account in Chronicles listing the cities given to the descendants of Kohath from Ephraim and Manasseh.
